items.summary: Interrogation: subject-pronoun inversion with -t-, rewriting questions in formal register.

Completing interrogative words by answer; shortening qui est-ce qui to qui.
Que/qui/quoi questions: shortening, matching and gap-fills.
Quel/quelle/quels/quelles gap-fills and rewriting form-style questions.
Questions with quel and où: forming questions about places and neighbourhood.
Où/d'où/par où and quand questions: transformations and question-forming.

Combien / combien de: matching and gap-fill drills on quantities and prices.
Combien questions about a company; synthesis question-forming on Burgundy and comics.
